comparisons.reason: Both read OC_comments and are binary, but the row functions differ. Feature 0 is 1 if any comment has calm, civil, structured reasoning against the OP, and hostile reasoning is excluded. Feature 1 is 1 only if some comment gives logical refutation AND no comment contains specific empirical evidence. That adds a dataset-wide exclusion on evidence. Feature 1 has no civility or tone requirement. Their 0 conditions differ. Feature 0 does not look at evidence, while feature 1 is 0 whenever evidence appears. The two also treat empty lists the same way, but this does not offset the construct difference.
